E0220

A place is read through its owner while an exclusive write window into it is still live.

What

A place is read through its owner while an exclusive write window into it is still live.

Why

An exclusive window (a pin or a mutable view) already gives write access to that storage; reading the owner beside it would be rejected after lowering.

Fix

Read or edit through the live window name instead of the owner.

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning E0220: tests/ui/read_owner_while_write_window.stderr.

Error [E0220]: `node.payload` cannot be read while `pinned` has a live pin into it
  --> tests/ui/read_owner_while_write_window.jet:11:13
    |
 11 |     if node.payload > 0 -> pinned.hops += 1
    |             ^^^^^^^
 Why: `pinned` is an exclusive window into `node`; reading the owner beside that window would be rejected after lowering
 Fix: read or edit through `pinned` instead of `node.payload`
